f3_program: observe(at("maria.monthly_salary.amount", "initial"), 2000, "dollar", source("Maria's monthly salary is $2000"))
percent_of("maria.tax_payment.amount", at("maria.monthly_salary.amount", "initial"), 20, source("20% of her salary goes to paying tax"))
remove("tax_payment", "maria", at("maria.monthly_salary.amount", "current"), "maria.tax_payment.amount", source("20% of her salary goes to paying tax"))
percent_of("maria.insurance_payment.amount", at("maria.monthly_salary.amount", "initial"), 5, source("5% goes to insurance"))
remove("insurance_payment", "maria", at("maria.monthly_salary.amount", "current"), "maria.insurance_payment.amount", source("5% goes to insurance"))

consume("utility_bills_payment", "maria", at("maria.monthly_salary.amount", "current"), fraction(at("maria.monthly_salary.amount", "current"), 1, 4), source("a quarter of the money left after the deductions is spent on utility bills"))
query("value", at("maria.monthly_salary.amount", "current"))
observe(at("debra.radio_show.interviewed_singers.count", "each_week"), 3, "count", source("Each week, she interviews three singers"))

collection("debra.radio_show.interview_segment_durations", "duration", "debra.radio_show", source("The first interview segment is always twice as long as the other two segments combined, and the third interview segment is always half as long as the second."))
member("debra.radio_show.interview_segment_durations", "debra.radio_show.interview_segments.first.duration", source("The first interview segment"))
member("debra.radio_show.interview_segment_durations", "debra.radio_show.interview_segments.second.duration", source("half as long as the second"))
member("debra.radio_show.interview_segment_durations", "debra.radio_show.interview_segments.third.duration", source("the third interview segment"))

multiple(at("debra.radio_show.interview_segments.first.duration", "current"), at("debra.radio_show.interview_segments.second_and_third.duration", "current"), 2, source("The first interview segment is always twice as long as the other two segments combined"))

sum_relation(at("debra.radio_show.interview_segments.second_and_third.duration", "current"), at("debra.radio_show.interview_segments.second.duration", "current"), at("debra.radio_show.interview_segments.third.duration", "current"), source("the other two segments combined"))

fraction_of(at("debra.radio_show.interview_segments.third.duration", "current"), at("debra.radio_show.interview_segments.second.duration", "current"), 1, 2, source("the third interview segment is always half as long as the second"))
observe(at("debra.radio_show.interview_segments.third.duration", "current"), 10, "minute", source("the third segment is 10 minutes long"))
query("sum", "debra.radio_show.interview_segment_durations", "current")
assumptions: The entire show consists of the three stated interview segments.

f3_program: observe(at("wire.reference_roll.length", "current"), 25, "meter", source("25 m wire"))
observe(at("wire.reference_roll.weight", "current"), 5, "kilogram", source("weighs 5 kg"))
rate_relation(at("wire.reference_roll.weight", "current"), "wire.weight_per_meter", at("wire.reference_roll.length", "current"), source("A roll of 25 m wire weighs 5 kg"))
observe(at("wire.target_roll.length", "current"), 75, "meter", source("75 m roll"))
rate_relation(at("wire.target_roll.weight", "current"), "wire.weight_per_meter", at("wire.target_roll.length", "current"), source("How much does a 75 m roll weigh?"))
query("value", at("wire.target_roll.weight", "current"))
assumptions: Both rolls contain the same kind of wire with constant weight per meter.

f3_program: multiple(at("geric.bills.count", "initial"), at("kyla.bills.count", "initial"), 2, source("Geric had twice as many bills as Kyla"))
offset(at("kyla.bills.count", "initial"), at("jessa.bills.count", "initial"), -2, "count", source("Kyla who has 2 fewer bills than Jessa"))
transfer("jessa_gives_geric_bills", "jessa", at("jessa.bills.count", "current"), at("geric.bills.count", "current"), 3, source("After giving 3 bills to Geric, Jessa has 7 bills left"))
observe(at("jessa.bills.count", "current"), 7, "count", source("Jessa has 7 bills left"))
query("value", at("geric.bills.count", "initial"))
